title: RAISE: Reinforcing Access Control Policy Synthesis in LLMs via Symbolic Evaluation
title_zh: RAISE: 通过符号评估强化 LLMs 中的访问控制策略合成

paragraphs.en: Translating natural-language access-control requirements into policies requires careful reasoning about permissions, constraints, and exceptions, and even frontier LLMs often produce policies that violate the intended authorization semantics. We construct CedarInstruct, to our knowledge the first dataset that supports both training and semantic evaluation for formally verifiable Cedar policy synthesis. It contains 5,800 scenarios across 44 domains and 1,408 representing a single synthetic organization, each with a verified target policy and an executable verification plan. On this data we introduce RAISE, which trains policy synthesizers from formal verification in two stages, verified supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by a reinforcement learning (RL) stage that learns from verifier signal. We find that SFT succeeds largely by letting models express authorization logic they already have, since untrained models rarely write valid Cedar but often reason correctly when they do. After SFT, how the verifier’s information is used matters more than how much of it is used. Of six RL instantiations that consume progressively richer verifier signal, only RAISE-OC improves meaningfully on SFT; it turns failed checks and symbolic counterexamples into guided exploration and learns from the result with off-context GRPO. With about 5.4K verified scenarios and LoRA fine-tuning, RAISE-OC trains Qwen3.5-9B to surpass zero-shot GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 by 13.33 and 16.26 percentage points in semantic success on held-out scenarios, and training transfers to the independently constructed CedarBench. The implementation is available at https://github.com/Aizhouym/raise .

paragraphs.en: Access control policies decide which principals may perform which actions on protected resources, and writing them precisely is hard. Manual policy configuration is error-prone, and deployed authorization often grants more access than intended ( Xiao et al., 2025 ; Cao et al., 2024 ) . Translating natural-language requirements into policies adds a further difficulty, because a policy must be both syntactically valid and faithful to the requirement’s authorization semantics ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) . We study this problem in Cedar, a declarative authorization language whose schemas and symbolic analysis tools support validation, policy comparison, and counterexample generation. ( Cutler et al., 2024 ) Appendix C.7 shows the following policy in Cedar and a short guide to reading Cedar policies. Consider a requirement from our dataset: finance managers may issue payments only during business hours, and only for approved invoices unless the request comes from the corporate network. A natural-looking policy that grants the network exception as a separate rule is valid Cedar, but it also lets managers on the corporate network issue payments outside business hours, which the requirement forbids. Mistakes like this, where an exception quietly overrides a restriction it was never meant to lift, are easy to make and hard to spot by reading the policy.

paragraphs.en: Even frontier models find it hard to write a correct policy in a single attempt. We check each generated policy against a verification plan , an executable set of symbolic checks that bound the access a policy may grant and specify the access it must grant. Against these plans, GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 produce valid Cedar for over 97% of our test scenarios but satisfy the full plan for only about a third (Section 5.2 ). Verifier-guided repair can close part of this gap ( Vatsa et al., 2026 ) , but it needs the verifier, the plan, and several model calls at deployment time. This paper asks whether a small open model can instead be trained to generate correct policies directly.
paragraphs.zh: 即使是前沿模型，也很难在一次尝试中写出正确的策略。 我们将每个生成的策略与验证计划进行比对；该验证计划是一组可执行的符号化检查，用于界定策略可能授予的访问权限，并明确其必须授予的访问权限。 在这些验证计划面前，GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Opus 5 能为超过 97% 的测试场景生成有效的 Cedar，但只有约三分之一的场景能完全满足整个计划（第 5.2 节）。 由验证器引导的修复可以部分弥合这一差距（Vatsa 等人，2026），但这需要在部署时同时具备验证器、计划以及多次模型调用。 本文探讨的是：是否可以用一个较小的开放模型来替代上述方法，直接训练其生成正确的策略。

paragraphs.en: Answering that question requires verified demonstrations and executable semantic criteria, so we first construct CedarInstruct, which contains 5,800 scenarios across 44 domains and 1,408 representing a single synthetic organization, each pairing a requirement and a Cedar schema with a verified target policy and a verification plan. Training on CedarInstruct follows a standard two-stage recipe. We first fine-tune the model on the verified target policies (SFT), and then continue with reinforcement learning (RL), rewarding each sampled policy that passes verification. The two stages turn out to behave very differently. SFT carries most of the improvement. Before training, many policies are not valid and the smaller model’s valid policies are rarely correct, while after SFT nearly every policy is valid and more of them are correct. SFT also plateaus quickly, since another epoch changes nothing (Section 6.1 ). RL, in contrast, has little to learn from. With nearly every policy now valid, the remaining errors are semantic, and for about a third of the inputs sampled during RL, every sampled policy fails verification, so a pass-or-fail reward gives the model no signal. Yet the verifier knows far more than pass or fail. It can identify which property each policy violates and produce a concrete request that witnesses the violation, and when we show these diagnostics to the model, it repairs many of its failures (Section 6.1 ). The missing signal is there to be used.
paragraphs.zh: 要回答这个问题，需要经过验证的演示和可执行的语义标准，因此我们首先构建了 CedarInstruct，它包含 44 个领域中的 5,800 个场景以及代表单个合成组织的 1,408 个场景，每个场景都将一个需求与一个 Cedar 模式、一个经过验证的目标策略和一个验证计划配对。 在 CedarInstruct 上的训练遵循标准的两阶段流程。 我们首先基于经过验证的目标策略对模型进行微调（SFT），然后继续采用强化学习（RL），对通过验证的每个采样策略给予奖励。 这两个阶段的实际表现差异很大。 SFT 贡献了大部分性能提升。 在训练之前，许多策略无效，而较小模型的有效策略也很少正确；但在 SFT 之后，几乎每个策略都有效，且其中更多策略是正确的。 SFT 的改进很快也会达到平台期，因为再运行一个周期也不会带来任何变化（第 6.1 节）。 相比之下，RL 几乎没有可学习的内容。 由于此时几乎所有策略都已有效，剩下的错误都是语义层面的；在 RL 期间采样的输入中，约有三分之一的输入会导致所有采样策略都未能通过验证，因此“通过/失败”的奖励无法为模型提供任何指导信号。 然而，验证器所掌握的信息远不止“通过”或“失败”。 它可以识别每个策略违反了哪项属性，并生成一个具体请求来证明该违规行为；当我们向模型展示这些诊断信息时，它能修复许多错误（第 6.1 节）。 缺失的指导信号其实就在那里，等待被利用。

paragraphs.en: We therefore introduce RAISE, which keeps this two-stage recipe but builds the RL stage around the verifier’s diagnostics rather than its pass-or-fail verdict. We instantiate the RL stage six ways, each adapted to Cedar synthesis and each consuming more verifier information than the last, from binary outcomes up to failed-check descriptions. The strongest instantiation, RAISE-OC, explores each verified failure in its own guided context and learns from it with off-context GRPO ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) . It is the only instantiation that improves meaningfully on SFT, even though two others receive the same failed-check descriptions, which suggests that how verifier information is used matters more than how much of it is used. The resulting 9B model surpasses zero-shot frontier models on held-out scenarios, and training transfers to the independently constructed CedarBench. Within a single organization’s fixed schema, training on about a thousand cases lets the model solve nearly all new requirement combinations.

paragraphs.en: This paper makes three contributions. We introduce RAISE (Section 4 ), a framework for learning from formal verification, instantiated six ways along a ladder of verifier information, including RAISE-OC’s construction of guidance from verification. paragraphs.en: A symbolic checker, which we call the verifier , decides these conditions using Cedar’s symbolic compiler ( cedar symcc ), which reduces each check to an SMT query ( Cutler et al., 2024 ) . paragraphs.en: Each multi-domain scenario starts from a structured specification, a machine-readable list of the actions the scenario governs and the rules that apply to each. Specifications are sampled from hand-written domain skeletons, which declare a domain’s roles, resources, attributes, and actions, and the 44 skeletons span 19 application areas. The rules combine constraints such as separation of duty, lifecycle gates, and overrides with conditions such as roles, thresholds, and network or time restrictions, and the sampler rejects duplicates so that every scenario is a distinct combination. GPT-5.5 then renders each specification as a natural-language requirement, and AutoCedar ( Vatsa et al., 2026 ) builds the schema, plan, reference policies, and target policy. We keep a scenario only if its policies validate and P ⋆ P^{\star} satisfies every check.
paragraphs.zh: 每个多领域场景都始于一个结构化规范，即一份机器可读的列表，其中列出了该场景所管理的操作以及适用于每一项操作的规则。 规范是从人工书写的领域骨架中采样而来的，这些骨架声明了一个领域的角色、资源、属性和操作，而 44 个骨架覆盖了 19 个应用领域。 规则将职责分离、生命周期关卡和覆盖等约束条件与角色、阈值以及网络或时间限制等条件相结合，并且采样器会拒绝重复项，以确保每个场景都是独特的组合。 随后，GPT-5.5 会将每个规范渲染为自然语言要求，而 AutoCedar（Vatsa 等人，2026）则会构建模式、计划、参考策略和目标策略。 只有当某个场景的策略通过验证且 P ⋆ P^{\star} 满足所有检查时，我们才会保留该场景。

paragraphs.en: Verified supervised fine-tuning. The first stage is supervised fine-tuning on verified target policies. The model learns to generate P ⋆ P^{\star} from q q , and only the policy tokens are supervised, with no intermediate reasoning. We hypothesize that this generalizes rather than memorizes. Lin et al. (2025) trace much of SFT’s apparent failure to generalize to frozen prompts, which let a model ignore its instructions, and find that SFT generalizes to new instructions when each prompt declares its own vocabulary. CedarInstruct has this property by construction, because every input declares its vocabulary through its schema and a valid policy must use it.
paragraphs.zh: 经过验证的监督微调。 第一阶段是对经过验证的目标策略进行监督微调。 模型学习从 q q 生成 P ⋆ P^{\star}，并且仅对策略标记进行监督，不涉及任何中间推理。 我们推测，这种方法能够泛化而非单纯记忆。Lin 等人 （2025）指出，SFT 在泛化方面表现不佳的主要原因在于固定提示词，这导致模型可以忽略其指令；他们发现，当每个提示词都声明自己的词汇表时，SFT 能够泛化到新的指令。 CedarInstruct 在设计上就具备这一特性，因为每个输入都通过其模式声明了自身的词汇表，而有效的策略必须使用该词汇表。

paragraphs.en: Learning from verifier signal. SFT still leaves many inputs unsolved, and the second stage learns from the verifier on exactly those. Since no established method trains access-control synthesizers on sound verifier feedback, we adapt six verifier-guided training methods and order them by how much of the verifier’s output each one uses (Table 1 ). paragraphs.en: Design rationale. RAISE-OC derives guidance from the verification plan and the behavior of the model’s own candidates, without consulting the target policy P ⋆ P^{\star} . Pooling failures prioritizes checks that block the most candidates, while assigning each selected check a separate context avoids combining unrelated diagnostics. Because every guided candidate is evaluated against the complete plan, fixing one check while violating another receives no reward. The off-context ratio and clipped surrogate follow OC-GRPO; RAISE-OC contributes the verifier-based aggregation, selection, and grouping of guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 设计原理。 RAISE-OC 从验证计划和模型自身候选体的行为中获取指导，而无需参考目标策略 P ⋆ P^{\star}。 池化失败会优先检查那些能阻止最多候选体的步骤，同时为每个选定的检查分配独立上下文，以避免将无关的诊断信息合并在一起。 由于每个受引导的候选体都会根据完整的计划进行评估，因此修复一个检查而违反另一个检查的行为不会获得任何奖励。 离上下文比率与裁剪代理遵循 OC-GRPO；RAISE-OC 的贡献在于基于验证器的指导信息聚合、选择和分组。

sents.zh: 池化失败会优先检查那些能阻止最多候选体的步骤，同时为每个选定的检查分配独立上下文，以避免将无关的诊断信息合并在一起。

sents.en: Because every guided candidate is evaluated against the complete plan, fixing one check while violating another receives no reward.
sents.zh: 由于每个受引导的候选体都会根据完整的计划进行评估，因此修复一个检查而违反另一个检查的行为不会获得任何奖励。

sents.en: The off-context ratio and clipped surrogate follow OC-GRPO; RAISE-OC contributes the verifier-based aggregation, selection, and grouping of guidance.

paragraphs.en: Models and training. We now test whether this recipe delivers a small model that writes correct policies, and whether the way RAISE-OC uses the verifier matters. We train Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B with LoRA in verl ( Sheng et al., 2025 ) on four NVIDIA H200 GPUs. Both backbones undergo three primary SFT epochs, followed by two epochs of each RL instantiation on the RL split, using a single training seed. For Qwen3.5-9B, we additionally run a fourth SFT epoch to assess saturation; all reported SFT results and subsequent RL runs use the epoch-3 checkpoint. RAISE-OC samples K = 8 K=8 candidates per input and turns at most M = 4 M=4 failed checks into guided contexts (Section 4.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 模型与训练。 我们现在测试这一方案能否生成一个能写出正确策略的小型模型，以及 RAISE-OC 使用验证器的方式是否重要。 我们在 verl（Sheng et al., 2025）中，使用四块 NVIDIA H200 GPU 对 Qwen3.5-9B 和 Qwen3.8-27B 进行 LoRA 训练。 两个基础模型都经过三轮主要 SFT 训练，随后在 RL 数据集上分别进行两轮不同 RL 实例的训练，且使用单一训练种子。 对于 Qwen3.5-9B，我们还额外运行了第四轮 SFT 训练以评估饱和状态；所有报告的 SFT 结果及后续的 RL 运行均使用第三轮训练的模型检查点。 RAISE-OC 为每个输入采样 K = 8 个候选者，并将最多 M = 4 次失败的检查转化为引导上下文（第 4.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Baselines and prompts. For comparison, we evaluate GPT-6 Astra (Max) ( OpenAI, 2026b ) and Claude Opus 5 (Max) ( Anthropic, 2026 ) with the zero-shot prompt of Appendix H , and we also report GPT-5.5, which helped construct the dataset, in Appendix F.1 . The untrained Qwen models receive a structured Cedar prompt instead, because with the plain prompt’s brief guidance only 0.00% and 0.27% of their policies are valid, as most generations fail parsing or schema validation before any semantic check. The structured prompt adds syntax patterns, schema-grounding constraints, and an output scaffold, which makes it the stronger baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 基线模型与提示词。 为进行比较，我们使用附录 H 中的零样本提示词评估了 GPT-6 Astra (Max)（OpenAI，2026b）和 Claude Opus 5 (Max)（Anthropic，2026），并在附录 F.1 中报告了用于构建数据集的 GPT-5.5 的结果。 未经训练的 Qwen 模型则接收结构化的 Cedar 提示词，因为使用普通提示词的简要指导时，仅有 0.00% 和 0.27% 的策略是有效的，因为大多数生成内容在语义检查之前就已失败于解析或模式验证。 结构化提示词增加了语法模式、基于模式的约束以及输出框架，这使其成为更强大的基线模型。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation metrics. Alongside semantic success we report syntax, the percentage of valid policies, and two measures of partial correctness based on individual checks. The macro score averages, over scenarios, the fraction of each scenario’s checks that the policy passes, so every scenario counts equally. The micro score pools all checks across scenarios and reports the fraction passed, so scenarios with more checks count more. An invalid policy passes no checks.
paragraphs.zh: 评估指标。 除了语义成功之外，我们还报告了句法正确率、有效策略的百分比，以及基于单个检查的两项部分正确性指标。 宏观分数对各个场景进行平均计算，即策略通过该场景中各项检查的比例，因此每个场景的权重相等。 微观分数则汇总所有场景中的全部检查，并报告通过检查的比例，因此检查数量多的场景权重更大。 无效策略无法通过任何检查。

paragraphs.en: In Table 2 , five of the six RL instantiations improve semantic success by at most 0.80 points over SFT on either backbone, and four of them fall below SFT on Qwen3.8-27B, including Critique-GRPO and SDPO, which see the same failed-check descriptions as RAISE-OC. Its validity is unchanged, so the gains come from getting the semantics right. Scores based on individual checks tell a less clear story, because passing more checks does not guarantee a correct policy. For Qwen3.8-27B, Coverage Reward GRPO scores marginally higher than RAISE-OC in macro and micro checks while solving fewer plans. paragraphs.en: The main results raise two questions. Why does SFT account for most of the gain, and why does RAISE-OC improve on it when other ways of using the verifier do not? We take them in turn, and then ask how far the results extend beyond the test split.

paragraphs.en: Semantic success requires validity, and before training many policies are not valid. Under structured zero-shot prompting, only 45.07% of Qwen3.5-9B’s policies and 79.73% of Qwen3.8-27B’s are valid, and correctness among the valid ones differs sharply between Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B. Only 5.9% of Qwen3.5-9B’s valid policies satisfy the full plan, whereas 36.1% of Qwen3.8-27B’s do, comparable to GPT-6 Astra (34.3%) and Claude Opus 5 (30.7%) on the same measure (Table 2 ). Our interpretation is that Qwen3.8-27B already brings authorization reasoning from pretraining, likely from code in other languages and other policy formats, but cannot yet express it reliably in Cedar. The SFT data teaches that expression, meaning Cedar’s syntax and how its constructs interact, such as permit and forbid rules, when and unless conditions, and schema-typed attributes. After SFT, validity rises above 99% for both Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B, and correctness among valid policies rises to 43.3% and 46.5%. For Qwen3.8-27B, this is consistent with the view that fine-tuning largely teaches models to express capabilities acquired in pretraining ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) , and it would help explain why about 4.4K demonstrations suffice. Qwen3.5-9B has less to unlock, since its valid policies are rarely correct before training, so for Qwen3.5-9B, SFT likely teaches reasoning as well as expression. The gap between Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B among valid policies accordingly narrows from 30.2 points before training to 3.2 points after. Both frontier models achieve near-perfect syntactic validity (97.87% and 100.00%), so their errors are unlikely to stem from unfamiliarity with Cedar and instead reflect the difficulty of the authorization reasoning itself.
paragraphs.zh: 语义上的成功需要有效性，而在训练之前，许多策略并不有效。 在结构化零样本提示下，Qwen3.5-9B 的策略中仅有 45.07% 是有效的，而 Qwen3.8-27B 的有效策略比例为 79.73%；在有效策略中，两者的正确率也存在显著差异。 Qwen3.5-9B 的有效策略中仅有 5.9% 满足完整计划，而 Qwen3.8-27B 的这一比例为 36.1%，与 GPT-6 Astra（34.3%）和 Claude Opus 5（30.7%）在同一指标上的表现相当（表 2）。 我们的解释是，Qwen3.8-27B 已经通过预训练获得了授权推理能力，这很可能源于其他语言代码和其他格式的策略，但它尚无法在 Cedar 中可靠地表达这种能力。 SFT 数据教会了模型如何表达这种能力，即 Cedar 的语法及其构造（例如允许和禁止规则、当……时和除非……否则条件以及模式类型属性）之间的相互作用方式。 经过 SFT 后，Qwen3.5-9B 和 Qwen3.8-27B 的有效性均超过 99%，有效策略中的正确率也分别提升至 43.3% 和 46.5%。 对于 Qwen3.8-27B 而言，这一结果与“微调主要教会模型如何表达预训练中获得的能力”的观点一致（Zhou et al., 2023），也有助于解释为何约 4.4K 个演示示例就足以实现目标。 Qwen3.5-9B 需要解锁的能力较少，因为其有效策略在训练前几乎不正确，因此对于 Qwen3.5-9B，SFT 很可能同时教会了推理和表达能力。 因此，有效策略中 Qwen3.5-9B 与 Qwen3.8-27B 之间的差距从训练前的 30.2 个百分点缩小到了训练后的 3.2 个百分点。 这两款前沿模型都实现了近乎完美的语法有效性（分别为 97.87% 和 100.00%），因此它们的错误不太可能源于对 Cedar 不熟悉，而更可能反映了授权推理本身的难度。

sents.en: Our interpretation is that Qwen3.8-27B already brings authorization reasoning from pretraining, likely from code in other languages and other policy formats, but cannot yet express it reliably in Cedar.
sents.zh: 我们的解释是，Qwen3.8-27B 已经通过预训练获得了授权推理能力，这很可能源于其他语言代码和其他格式的策略，但它尚无法在 Cedar 中可靠地表达这种能力。

sents.en: The SFT data teaches that expression, meaning Cedar’s syntax and how its constructs interact, such as permit and forbid rules, when and unless conditions, and schema-typed attributes.
sents.zh: SFT 数据教会了模型如何表达这种能力，即 Cedar 的语法及其构造（例如允许和禁止规则、当……时和除非……否则条件以及模式类型属性）之间的相互作用方式。

sents.en: After SFT, validity rises above 99% for both Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B, and correctness among valid policies rises to 43.3% and 46.5%.
sents.zh: 经过 SFT 后，Qwen3.5-9B 和 Qwen3.8-27B 的有效性均超过 99%，有效策略中的正确率也分别提升至 43.3% 和 46.5%。

sents.en: For Qwen3.8-27B, this is consistent with the view that fine-tuning largely teaches models to express capabilities acquired in pretraining ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) , and it would help explain why about 4.4K demonstrations suffice.
sents.zh: 对于 Qwen3.8-27B 而言，这一结果与“微调主要教会模型如何表达预训练中获得的能力”的观点一致（Zhou et al., 2023），也有助于解释为何约 4.4K 个演示示例就足以实现目标。

sents.en: Qwen3.5-9B has less to unlock, since its valid policies are rarely correct before training, so for Qwen3.5-9B, SFT likely teaches reasoning as well as expression.
sents.zh: Qwen3.5-9B 需要解锁的能力较少，因为其有效策略在训练前几乎不正确，因此对于 Qwen3.5-9B，SFT 很可能同时教会了推理和表达能力。

sents.en: The gap between Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B among valid policies accordingly narrows from 30.2 points before training to 3.2 points after.
sents.zh: 因此，有效策略中 Qwen3.5-9B 与 Qwen3.8-27B 之间的差距从训练前的 30.2 个百分点缩小到了训练后的 3.2 个百分点。

sents.en: Both frontier models achieve near-perfect syntactic validity (97.87% and 100.00%), so their errors are unlikely to stem from unfamiliarity with Cedar and instead reflect the difficulty of the authorization reasoning itself.
sents.zh: 这两款前沿模型都实现了近乎完美的语法有效性（分别为 97.87% 和 100.00%），因此它们的错误不太可能源于对 Cedar 不熟悉，而更可能反映了授权推理本身的难度。

paragraphs.en: If SFT mainly teaches a language, more of it should not help much, and it does not. A further SFT epoch on the original 4,386 scenarios does not improve Qwen3.5-9B, and a further epoch on the 1,039 RL-partition scenarios, the same data RAISE-OC learns from, lowers its semantic success by 5.60 points (Appendix D ). Further progress, therefore, needs a different training signal.
paragraphs.zh: 如果 SFT 主要是在教授一门语言，那么更多的 SFT 数据应该不会有太大帮助，事实也确实如此。 对原始的 4,386 个场景进行额外的 SFT 训练并未提升 Qwen3.5-9B 的性能；而对 RL 分区中的 1,039 个场景（即 RAISE-OC 所学习到的相同数据）进行额外训练，则使其语义成功率下降了 5.60 分（附录 D）。 因此，要实现进一步的进步，需要一种不同的训练信号。

paragraphs.en: Once nearly every policy is valid, the remaining failures are semantic, and under binary-reward GRPO, 38.57% and 33.06% of sampled groups contain no correct candidate for the 9B and 27B models (Figure 2 ), so they contribute nothing to learning. These are the inputs where the model is most wrong, and they are also where the verifier has the most to say, since beyond pass or fail it can report the fraction and identity of the checks a candidate passes and, for each failed check, a description of the violated property and often a concrete counterexample. At inference time, giving the SFT model its failed-check descriptions and counterexamples and asking it to repair its policy raises semantic success by 21.07 points on Qwen3.5-9B, from 42.93% to 64.00%, whereas a retry that reports only failure adds 2 (Appendix F.5 ). The richest information is therefore directly useful to the model, and because its content rather than the extra attempt does most of the work, it serves, in the terms of Section 2 , as guidance that raises the chance of success where the unguided model fails, without any reference solution.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦几乎所有策略都有效，剩下的失败就属于语义层面的问题；在二元奖励的 GRPO 中，对于 9B 和 27B 模型，38.57% 和 33.06% 的采样组不包含任何正确的候选方案（图 2），因此它们对学习毫无贡献。 这些是模型表现最差的输入，也是验证器最有发言权的场景：除了通过或失败之外，验证器还能报告候选方案通过的检查项的比例和具体名称，并对每个未通过的检查项说明所违反的特性，通常还会提供一个具体的反例。 在推理阶段，向 SFT 模型提供其未通过检查的描述和反例，并要求其修复策略，可使 Qwen3.5-9B 的语义成功率提升 21.07 个百分点，从 42.93% 升至 64.00%；而仅报告失败的重试则只增加了 2（附录 F.5）。 因此，最丰富的信息对模型具有直接用途；由于主要起作用的是信息内容本身而非额外的尝试，根据第 2 节的定义，这些信息充当了指导作用：在没有参考解决方案的情况下，它提升了未受指导模型在失败场景下的成功概率。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 isolates each component of RAISE-OC, with every change measured relative to SFT. Without SFT, binary-reward GRPO fails on both backbones. Qwen3.5-9B produces no valid policies, so every reward is zero, and Qwen3.8-27B reaches 27.20%, below the 28.80% it achieves with the structured prompt alone. After SFT, binary-reward GRPO changes semantic success by + 0.54 +0.54 points on Qwen3.5-9B and − 1.60 -1.60 on Qwen3.8-27B. With verifier-guided exploration and an uncorrected update, the changes become + 1.34 +1.34 and + 0.80 +0.80 . This variant samples under feedback-augmented prompts but computes the loss under the original input q q , without the off-context correction. With the correction, which gives RAISE-OC, they become + 4.00 +4.00 and + 1.60 +1.60 , so the guidance helps with either update and most with the correction. Within the guidance, selecting checks by frequency, exploring each in its own context, and pooling failures across candidates each outperform their alternatives (Appendix F.4 ). Figure 2 shows where the gain comes from. Guided exploration lowers RAISE-OC’s all-failure rate from 35.28% to 22.64% on Qwen3.5-9B and from 31.64% to 17.87% on Qwen3.8-27B, recovering a learning signal for about 13% of all sampled groups. Part of this recovery comes from drawing K K additional candidates per all-failure input, but the repair result above suggests that the diagnostics’ content, not the extra attempts, does most of the work.
paragraphs.zh: 表3隔离了RAISE-OC的每个组件，其中每一项变化都是相对于SFT测量的。 没有SFT的情况下，二元奖励GRPO在两种骨干模型上均会失败。 Qwen3.5-9B未能生成任何有效策略，因此所有奖励均为零；而Qwen3.8-27B的得分为27.20%，低于仅使用结构化提示时达到的28.80%。 经过SFT后，二元奖励GRPO在Qwen3.5-9B上的语义成功度变化为+0.54分，在Qwen3.8-27B上则为−1.60分。 在采用验证器引导探索且未进行修正更新的情况下，这些变化变为+1.34分和+0.80分。 该变体在反馈增强提示下采样，但损失计算基于原始输入q q，不包含上下文外的修正。 加入修正后（即RAISE-OC），这些变化变为+4.00分和+1.60分，表明引导对两种更新均有帮助，尤其在修正后效果更显著。 在引导机制中，按频率选择检查项、在各自上下文中探索每个检查项，以及跨候选者汇总失败情况，这些方法均优于其替代方案（附录F.4）。 图2展示了这一增益的来源。 引导探索将RAISE-OC的全失败率从Qwen3.5-9B的35.28%降至22.64%，从Qwen3.8-27B的31.64%降至17.87%，为约13%的采样组恢复了学习信号。 这种恢复部分源于每次全失败输入时额外抽取K个候选者，但上述修复结果表明，诊断内容而非额外的尝试贡献了主要效果。

paragraphs.en: Our test scenarios are new, but they come from the same 44 domains as the training data, with the same roles, resources, and actions. We therefore evaluate on two further settings. The first is CedarBench, whose scenarios were built independently of CedarInstruct. The second is a single organization that keeps the same schema and actions while its access rules change, tested on rule combinations unseen in training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的测试场景是全新的，但它们与训练数据来自相同的 44 个领域，并且具有相同的角色、资源和动作。 因此，我们在另外两种设置上进行评估。 第一种是 CedarBench，其场景是独立于 CedarInstruct 构建的。 第二种是一个单一组织，它保留了相同的模式和动作，但访问规则发生了变化，并在训练时未见过的规则组合上进行了测试。

paragraphs.en: CedarBench ( Vatsa et al., 2026 ) was built independently of CedarInstruct. To match CedarInstruct’s input format, we convert CedarBench’s inputs into natural-language requirements using GPT-5.5 with the rendering prompt of Listing , and we keep CedarBench’s original verification plans and scoring. None of its 221 scenarios is used for training or model selection. Training transfers substantially (Table 5 ). SFT raises semantic success from 0.00% to 39.37% on Qwen3.5-9B and from 1.36% to 49.77% on Qwen3.8-27B. RAISE-OC is best on both backbones, reaching 43.44% and 52.49%, which is 4.07 and 2.71 points above SFT, whereas binary-reward GRPO gains 3.17 and 0.00. On Qwen3.8-27B, RAISE-OC’s gain comes despite lower syntax validity than SFT, so it improves the correctness of valid policies rather than their validity. Frontier models were not evaluated on CedarBench, so the frontier comparison applies only to CedarInstruct.
paragraphs.zh: CedarBench（Vatsa 等人，2026）是独立于 CedarInstruct 构建的。 为了匹配 CedarInstruct 的输入格式，我们使用 GPT-5.5 和列表中的渲染提示，将 CedarBench 的输入转换为自然语言需求，同时保留 CedarBench 原有的验证计划和评分机制。 其 221 个场景均未用于训练或模型选择。 训练效果有显著提升（表 5）。 SFT 使 Qwen3.5-9B 的语义成功率从 0.00% 提升至 39.37%，Qwen3.8-27B 的语义成功率从 1.36% 提升至 49.77%。 RAISE-OC 在这两种基础模型上表现最佳，分别达到 43.44% 和 52.49%，比 SFT 高出 4.07 个和 2.71 个百分点，而二元奖励的 GRPO 仅提升了 3.17 个和 0.00 个百分点。 在 Qwen3.8-27B 上，尽管 RAISE-OC 的语法有效性低于 SFT，但其效果仍有提升，这表明它改进了有效策略的正确性，而非其有效性本身。 Frontier 模型未在 CedarBench 上进行评估，因此前沿模型比较仅适用于 CedarInstruct。

paragraphs.en: A deployed synthesizer faces a different kind of shift. An organization typically keeps its schema and actions fixed while its requirements change, and we study this setting with the 1,408 CedarInstruct scenarios that represent a single synthetic organization. They share one document-and-approval schema and six actions (read, edit, share, approve, delete, and manage access), and we split them by rule combination into 1,024 training, 128 development, and 256 test cases, so every test case is a combination of rules unseen in training. Starting from the SFT checkpoint, we train Qwen3.5-9B for one epoch with a variant of the SDPO instantiation whose self-teacher is conditioned on the verified reference policy and on verified repair histories. We use this variant rather than RAISE-OC because the setting is narrow. With the schema and actions fixed, the same rules and checks recur across cases, much like a small game, so we expect correct policies to be easier to reach and the all-failure inputs that RAISE-OC targets to be rarer, while a teacher that sees the verified reference provides a dense learning signal. One model receives the requirement and schema, and a second also receives the verification plan, as an organization that maintains its requirements as checkable properties could provide. After training, the model given the requirement and schema solves 243 of 256 test cases and the model also given the plan solves 248 (Table 5 ), so modest organization-specific training lets Qwen3.5-9B handle new requirement combinations almost without error. Before organization-specific training, the SFT checkpoint solves only 7.81% of these test cases, against 42.93% on the CedarInstruct test split, so a single organization’s rules can differ substantially from our multi-domain data. Adding the plan raises its success to 58.20%, which suggests that the plan’s atomic properties are useful scaffolding.

paragraphs.en: Four instantiations use more verifier information than a binary outcome, and two use the same failed-check descriptions as RAISE-OC, yet only RAISE-OC improves meaningfully over SFT. This suggests that the difference lies in how the feedback is used. Critique-GRPO refines candidates that have already failed, SDPO distills a feedback-conditioned teacher into the student’s own, mostly failing, candidates, and neither corrects for the guided context. RAISE-OC instead samples fresh candidates under short, targeted guidance and learns from them off-context, which is where Section 2 predicts guidance is most useful.
paragraphs.zh: 四种实现方式使用的验证器信息比二元结果更多，其中两种还使用了与 RAISE-OC 相同的检查失败描述，但只有 RAISE-OC 在效果上显著优于 SFT。 这表明差异在于反馈的使用方式。 Critique-GRPO 会改进已经失败的候选方案，而 SDPO 则将基于反馈的教师模型内化为学生自身（多数失败的）候选方案，两者都没有对引导上下文进行修正。 相比之下，RAISE-OC 会在简短且有针对性的引导下生成新的候选方案，并在脱离该上下文时从中学习，而这正是第 2 节所预测的引导最有用之处。

paragraphs.en: This guidance is exact because Cedar is deliberately not Turing-complete, so whether a policy satisfies a check is decided by an SMT solver rather than estimated with tests ( Cutler et al., 2024 ) . RAISE should therefore transfer most directly to other policy and configuration languages that can be analyzed the same way. The organizational study suggests a practical deployment path, in which a broadly trained model is adapted to one organization’s fixed schema with about a thousand verified cases (Section 6.2 ). Since SFT here is answer-only, the atomic properties of each plan also offer a natural reasoning scaffold, a direction supported by Lin et al. (2025) , who find that chain-of-thought supervision helps on harder instances.
paragraphs.zh: 这一指导原则之所以精确，是因为 Cedar 在设计上并非图灵完备的，因此一项策略是否通过检查是由 SMT 求解器决定的，而不是通过测试进行估算（Cutler 等人，2024）。因此，RAISE 应该能够最直接地迁移到其他同样可以进行分析的策略和配置语言中。该组织研究提出了一条可行的部署路径：首先使用一个经过广泛训练的智能体模型，然后利用大约一千个经过验证的案例，将其适配到某个组织的固定模式上（第 6.2 节）。由于此处的 SFT 仅要求提供答案，每个计划的原子属性也为此提供了一个自然的推理框架；Lin 等人（2025）的研究也支持这一方向，他们发现“思维链”监督方法在处理更复杂的实例时更为有效。

paragraphs.en: Our study has several limitations. Correctness is defined by generated verification plans, whose fidelity symbolic checking cannot establish and which we assess only through sampled human and LLM review. Because the same pipeline defines the reward and the test grading, trained models may partly learn its reading of ambiguous requirements.All results use a single training seed, so margins as small as 4 of 375 test scenarios (RAISE-OC over the strongest other instantiation on Qwen3.8-27B) could partly reflect run-to-run variation. Guided exploration also draws extra samples, and we did not compare verifier guidance with reference-solution prefixes or LLM-written hints (Appendix G ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究存在若干局限性。 正确性由生成的验证计划定义，而符号化检查无法确定这些计划的保真度，我们仅通过抽样的人类和大型语言模型（LLM）评审来评估它们。 由于同一流程定义了奖励机制和测试评分，训练后的模型可能会部分学会其对模糊需求的解读。所有结果均使用单一训练种子，因此即使差异小至 375 个测试场景中的 4 个（RAISE-OC 在 Qwen3.8-27B 上优于其他最强实现），也可能部分反映不同运行之间的差异。 引导式探索还会引入额外样本，而我们并未将验证器引导与参考解决方案的前缀或大型语言模型（LLM）编写的提示进行比较（附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: Prior work applies LLMs to access-control policy generation through prompting and fine-tuning ( Lawal et al., 2024 ; Vatsa et al., 2025b ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Jayasundara et al., 2026 ) . AutoCedar instead uses symbolic verification for inference-time repair ( Vatsa et al., 2026 ) , whereas we use verification to train the generator. In reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards ( Le et al., 2022 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) , GRPO estimates advantages from within-group reward differences ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . Uninformative groups have been addressed through filtering and resampling ( Yu et al., 2026 ) , adaptive task difficulty ( Zeng et al., 2025 ) , and hierarchical hints ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Feedback has supported both inference-time refinement ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Gou et al., 2024 ) and training in Critique-GRPO and SDPO ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Hübotter et al., 2026 ) , which we adapt as RAISE instantiations. Closest to RAISE-OC, adaptive OC-GRPO retries failed prompts with progressively stronger tutor-generated hints ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) . RAISE-OC instead derives guidance from formal verification of the model’s own candidates, pools failures across candidates, and explores each selected property in its own context. Appendix A provides a fuller review.

paragraphs.en: Small open models can learn to translate access-control requirements into verified Cedar policies better than zero-shot frontier models, from a few thousand verified scenarios and without verifier feedback at inference. Verified SFT does most of the work, making nearly every policy valid and more often correct, but it plateaus, and more supervised data does not help. Beyond that point, the verifier’s diagnostics supply the missing signal, and how they are used decides whether they help. Of six ways of learning from verification, only exploring each verified failure in its own guided context and learning from it off-context improves meaningfully on SFT. Training transfers to independently built scenarios, and a synthesizer adapts to a single organization’s requirements from about a thousand examples.

paragraphs.en: This research follows established research ethics principles. Our objective is to improve the reliability of access control policy synthesis by integrating formal verification with language model training. We acknowledge the security risks of incorrectly generated policies, including unintended permissions and denial of legitimate access. Our symbolic verification guarantees are limited to the specified verification plans. CedarInstruct is constructed from synthetic scenarios, without real-world personal or sensitive authorization data. We encourage deploying generated policies with independent validation and human oversight.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究遵循既定的研究伦理原则。 我们的目标是通过将形式化验证与语言模型训练相结合，提升访问控制策略合成的可靠性。 我们认识到错误生成的策略可能带来安全风险，包括意外权限和拒绝合法访问等问题。 我们的符号化验证保证仅限于指定的验证计划。 CedarInstruct 由合成场景构建而成，不包含现实世界中个人身份或敏感授权数据。 我们建议在对生成策略进行独立验证并实施人工监督后再部署使用。

paragraphs.en: Earlier work on natural-language policy authoring extracted access-control rules from textual requirements ( Xiao et al., 2012 ; Slankas et al., 2014 ) and constructed authorization models from policy statements ( Abdelgawad et al., 2023 ) . Recent studies investigate LLM prompting for policy extraction and synthesis, including whether generated policies preserve the intended authorization behavior ( Lawal et al., 2024 ; Vatsa et al., 2025b ; Vatsa et al., 2025a ) . Beyond prompting, Yang et al. (2025) fine-tune CodeT5 on GPT-4-generated data to extract ABAC rules from natural-language text. AGentVLM uses small open-source language models for structured policy extraction and provides verification feedback to support policy revision ( Jayasundara et al., 2026 ) . Formal analysis complements policy generation by checking authorization behavior against specified properties. Zelkova and Cedar support symbolic reasoning about policies, including comparisons of the requests they allow ( Backes et al., 2018 ; Cutler et al., 2024 ) . Verification also supports policy modification. Restricter tightens Cedar policies against access logs, while CloudFix combines formal fault localization with LLM-generated repairs checked by SMT solvers ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Hall et al., 2026 ) . AutoCedar constructs reviewed schemas and boundary plans specifying required permissions, upper bounds on permitted access, and liveness conditions, and uses symbolic verification to guide policy generation and repair ( Vatsa et al., 2026 ) . Our focus is on using the resulting verification feedback to train the generator, rather than solely to assess and repair individual candidate policies.

paragraphs.en: Verification results can serve as training rewards for policy generation. This follows the broader reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) paradigm, which trains language models using automatically assessed outcomes in mathematical reasoning and code generation ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2025 ) . Earlier code-generation methods use execution outcomes, learned critics, fine-grained unit-test feedback, and code-completion curricula to guide learning ( Le et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Dou et al., 2024 ) . GRPO estimates advantages relative to responses sampled for the same prompt, avoiding a separately trained value model ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . Subsequent methods and analyses examine how reward normalization and policy regularization affect optimization ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Mroueh, 2026 ) . Sampling becomes particularly important when rewards offer little variation within a group. In GRPO with binary outcome rewards, groups containing only successful or only unsuccessful responses yield zero group-relative advantages. DAPO maintains informative training batches by filtering such groups and replenishing them through additional sampling ( Yu et al., 2026 ) , while RLVE adapts the difficulty of procedurally generated tasks to the evolving policy ( Zeng et al., 2025 ) . For policy generation, symbolic verification can identify violated authorization properties and, when available, return concrete requests that witness those violations. Descriptions of the violated properties and the corresponding counterexamples can guide subsequent policy generation, but this information is not conveyed by an aggregate correctness reward alone.
paragraphs.zh: 验证结果可以用作策略生成的训练奖励。 这遵循了更广泛的“带可验证奖励的强化学习”（RLVR）范式，该范式通过自动评估数学推理和代码生成任务的结果来训练语言模型（Guo 等，2025；Team 等，2025）。 早期的代码生成方法利用执行结果、学习到的批评模型、细粒度单元测试反馈以及代码补全课程来指导学习（Le 等，2022；Liu 等，2023；Dou 等，2024）。 GRPO 通过比较同一提示下采样得到的响应来估计优势值，从而避免使用单独训练的价值模型（Shao 等，2024）。 后续的方法和研究表明奖励归一化与策略正则化如何影响优化过程（Liu 等，2025；Mroueh，2026）。 当奖励在同一组内变化不大时，采样变得尤为重要。 在采用二元结果奖励的 GRPO 中，仅包含成功响应或仅包含失败响应的分组将产生零的组相对优势值。 DAPO 通过过滤此类分组并通过额外采样补充新样本，来维持具有信息价值的训练批次（Yu 等，2026）；而 RLVE 则根据策略的演变动态调整程序生成任务的难度（Zeng 等，2025）。 在策略生成中，符号验证能够识别被违反的授权属性，并在条件允许时返回能证明这些违规的具体请求。 对被违反属性的描述以及相应的反例可以指导后续的策略生成，但仅靠一个汇总的正确性奖励无法传递这些信息。

paragraphs.en: Beyond scalar rewards, natural-language critiques and tool feedback have been used to guide iterative refinement without updating model parameters ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Gou et al., 2024 ) . Training-based approaches teach models to revise their outputs through supervised learning and multi-turn reinforcement learning ( Qu et al., 2024 ; Kumar et al., 2025 ; Jiao et al., 2026 ) . Related methods jointly train solution generation and correctness assessment using verifiable outcomes ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Ruan et al., 2026 ) . More directly related to learning from assisted generations, Critique-GRPO uses natural-language critiques to generate refinements and optimizes both initial responses and refinements during online training ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . SDPO uses a feedback-conditioned version of the model as a self-teacher and distills its next-token distributions into the policy conditioned on the original prompt ( Hübotter et al., 2026 ) . Learning from assisted generations also requires accounting for how the training responses are obtained. LUFFY combines off-policy demonstrations with on-policy rollouts and uses policy shaping to balance imitation and exploration ( Yan et al., 2026 ) . OC-GRPO instead studies a mismatch in conditioning, generating rollouts with privileged guidance while optimizing an importance-corrected objective under the original prompt ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) . Our work investigates how structured evidence from formal verification can be used during training to improve the semantic correctness of generated access-control policies.

paragraphs.en: We build each scenario e i e_{i} through the four-stage pipeline shown in Figure 3 . First, the sampler draws a structured specification ω i \omega_{i} from a domain-constrained scenario space. Second, an LLM renders ω i \omega_{i} into a natural-language requirement D i D_{i} . Third, AutoCedar uses D i D_{i} to generate the Cedar schema Σ i \Sigma_{i} , boundary plan Π i \Pi_{i} , target policy bundle P i ⋆ P_{i}^{\star} , and reference policies ℛ i \mathcal{R}_{i} . Finally, every generated scenario undergoes executable validation. To assess construction faithfulness, we additionally conduct an LLM-based review on a sample of the retained scenarios and manually audit a subset of the LLM-reviewed sample using the same criteria. Thus, every retained scenario passes executable verification, whereas faithfulness is assessed through sampled LLM and human review rather than exhaustive per-scenario review.

paragraphs.en: The sampler builds each anchor block from two controlled vocabularies. Constraint categories K1–K5 describe the structural access-control constraints assigned to an anchor action (Table 6 ). Condition types V1–V14 describe additional predicates attached to those constraints (Table 7 ). We include constraints evaluable from the current request and stored entity fields. paragraphs.en: A Cedar policy bundle is a set of permit and forbid rules. Each rule names the principals, actions, and resources it applies to, and may add conditions in when clauses (the rule applies only if the condition holds) and unless clauses (the rule applies only if it does not). A request is allowed if and only if at least one permit rule applies and no forbid rule applies. We illustrate with the invoice-payment scenario of Appendix C.6 , which allows finance managers to issue payments only during business hours, and only for approved invoices unless the request comes from the corporate network.
paragraphs.zh: Cedar 策略包是一组允许和禁止规则。 每条规则都指明了其适用的主体、行为和资源，并可通过 when 子句（仅当条件成立时规则适用）和 unless 子句（仅当条件不成立时规则适用）添加附加条件。 当且仅当至少有一条允许规则适用且没有禁止规则适用时，请求才被允许。 我们以附录 C.6 中的发票支付场景为例进行说明：该场景允许财务经理仅在办公时间、且仅针对已批准的发票发起支付，除非请求来自企业内网。

paragraphs.en: We implement a Cedar-specific adaptation of Critique-GRPO ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Each prompt produces six initial candidates, and failed candidates with verifier feedback undergo up to two refinement rounds. Each round uses at most two failed-check descriptions, prioritizing over-permissive before over-restrictive failures; no separate critic or counterexample is used. We retain two refinements, prioritizing correct candidates, and combine them with the six initial candidates. If fewer than two refinements are available, the best available refinement or an initial candidate is reused. Binary rewards are centered over the combined group without standard-deviation normalization. Initial candidates use the clipped policy-gradient objective, while refinement tokens use the shaping factor p / ( p + 0.1 ) p/(p+0.1) under the original input, without context correction or reference-policy KL regularization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们实现了针对 Cedar 的 Critique-GRPO（Zhang 等人，2025）的特定适配版本。 每个提示会生成六个初始候选项，而经过验证器反馈后失败的候选项最多会经历两轮优化。 每轮最多使用两个检查失败描述，优先采用过度宽松的失败情况而非过度严格的失败情况；过程中不使用独立的批评者或反例。 我们保留两个优化结果，优先选择正确的候选项，并将其与六个初始候选项合并。 如果可用的优化结果少于两个，则会重复使用最佳可用优化结果或某个初始候选项。 二元奖励以合并后的组别为中心计算，且未进行标准差归一化。 初始候选项采用截断策略梯度目标函数，而优化标记则在原始输入下使用塑形因子 p / ( p + 0.1 ) p/(p+0.1)，且不进行上下文修正或参考策略 KL 正则化。

paragraphs.en: Table 9 ablates RAISE-OC’s guidance. The last comparison is the closest analogue in our experiments to guidance built from a single failed attempt ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) , though both variants here use verifier feedback. Larger budgets did not help: M = 8 M=8 with 16 guided rollouts reaches 45.60%. Most configurations were run only on Qwen3.5-9B with a single seed, so we treat these comparisons as indicative.

paragraphs.en: Table 10 applies verifier feedback at inference time. On every model, one round of repair with failed-check descriptions and counterexamples raises semantic success by 19 to 31 points, whereas a retry that reports only failure adds 2 to 7. The content of verifier feedback, not the extra attempt, drives most of the gain, which is the property RAISE-OC’s guided exploration relies on during training. RAISE-OC also improves the starting point for repair: after two rounds it reaches 70.40% on Qwen3.5-9B, versus 67.73% for SFT. Trained models and verifier-guided repair are therefore complementary.
paragraphs.zh: 表 10 在推理阶段应用验证器反馈。 在所有模型上，一轮包含失败检查描述和反例的修复可将语义成功率提升 19 至 31 个百分点，而仅报告失败的重试则只能提升 2 至 7 个百分点。 验证器反馈的内容（而非额外的尝试）是提升效果的主要来源，这也是 RAISE-OC 在训练期间依赖其引导探索的关键特性。 RAISE-OC 还改进了修复的起点：经过两轮修复后，Qwen3.5-9B 的成功率可达 70.40%，而 SFT 仅为 67.73%。 因此，训练模型与验证器引导的修复是互补的。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 reports failure rates within each check class. paragraphs.en: Table 11 reports latencies of 3.85 and 7.35 seconds per scenario for the RAISE-OC models, versus 14.3 and 27.3 seconds for GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5. The frontier figures are measured through each provider’s agent CLI (Codex CLI and Claude Code), not as raw API calls: the task prompt itself is under 1K tokens, but an agent loop resends its full context on every call, so the reported input tokens are summed over all calls, include prompt-cache reads and writes, and contain a fixed harness context much larger than the prompt. Output tokens include reasoning tokens. At estimated costs of $0.000093 and $0.000370 per scenario, the RAISE-OC models are about 686 × 686\times and 172 × 172\times cheaper than GPT-6 Astra, the less expensive of the two frontier models in Table 2 ; because the frontier costs include this harness overhead, the ratios describe end-to-end deployment rather than bare API calls. Latency and cost depend on the provider, hardware, and prompt configuration, so these measurements characterize the evaluated deployments only.
paragraphs.zh: 表 11 报告了 RAISE-OC 模型在每个场景下的延迟分别为 3.85 秒和 7.35 秒，而 GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Opus 5 的延迟则为 14.3 秒和 27.3 秒。 前沿模型的数值是通过各提供商的智能体 CLI（Codex CLI 和 Claude Code）测量的，而非原始 API 调用：任务提示本身少于 1K 个词元，但智能体循环会在每次调用时重新发送其完整上下文，因此报告的输入词元是所有调用的总和，包括提示缓存的读写操作，并包含一个远大于提示本身的固定辅助上下文。 输出词元包含推理词元。 以每个场景约 0.000093 美元和 0.000370 美元的估算成本计算，RAISE-OC 模型比 GPT-6 Astra（表 2 中两个前沿模型中较便宜的一个）分别便宜约 686 倍和 172 倍；由于前沿模型的成本包含了这一辅助开销，因此这些比率反映的是端到端部署而非单纯的 API 调用成本。 延迟和成本取决于提供商、硬件和提示配置，因此这些测量结果仅用于描述所评估的部署环境。

paragraphs.en: Symbolic checking establishes that a policy satisfies its verification plan, not that it matches every reading of the requirement. Plans are generated by AutoCedar with GPT-5.5, and their faithfulness to the requirements is assessed on a sample rather than exhaustively (Section 3 ). Because the same pipeline defines the RL reward, the feedback, and the test-set grading, trained models may partly learn the pipeline’s reading of ambiguous requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 符号化检查可以确定一项策略是否满足其验证计划，但无法确定该策略是否与需求的每一种解读完全一致。 AutoCedar 使用 GPT-5.5 生成计划，并通过样本而非穷尽性方法评估这些计划对需求的忠实度（第 3 节）。 由于相同的流程定义了强化学习的奖励、反馈和测试集评分，训练后的模型可能会部分学会该流程对模糊需求的解读方式。
